how-33-02-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the page, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-33-02-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the page, then tap three things you notice.

how-33-02-compare.page: Put the hatchling under one beach and the low lights under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a beach. Press Let the hatchlings go. Then swap.
how-33-02-compare.say: Put the hatchling under one beach and the low lights under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a beach. Press Let the hatchlings go. Then swap.

how-33-02-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.
how-33-02-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.

how-33-02-det.page: Pick 3 cards, one at a time. Tap something you see, then name the science topic. Predict what scientists figured out, and see the evidence.
how-33-02-det.say: Pick three cards, one at a time. Tap something you see, then name the science topic. Predict what scientists figured out, and see the evidence.

how-33-02-partc.page: Make your "My Year as a Scientist" page. Draw a model of your scenario with at least 3 labels and arrows that show cause and effect.
how-33-02-partc.say: Make your My Year as a Scientist page. Draw a model of your scenario with at least three labels and arrows that show cause and effect.
